thread:
maria: Quick thread — proposal for safetensors writeback atomicity and recovery playbook.

maria: After conversion/quant we sometimes have partial shards if the process is killed. Proposal: use a staging/versioned upload + final manifest commit as a single authoritative pointer. Also add loader-side zip fallback to allow graceful reads when some shards are missing.

ben: +1. Need checksums per-shard + manifest 'committed' boolean. If manifest missing we try recovery.

deepa: 2PC/coordinator is heavyweight. Alternative: per-shard write-to-temp + atomic rename for POSIX, then write manifest last and fsync. Pros: simple; Cons: doesn't work for S3/remote stores.

chris: Right — object stores don't have atomic rename. For cloud we should write to staging/<version>/* and then PUT manifest.json with conditional operation (e.g. if-none-match or expected-version). Loader reads manifest and resolves the staging version. Pseudocode:
```
# uploader
upload('staging/v123/shard-000')
... upload shards ...
manifest = {version: 'v123', shards: [...checksums...]}
put_object('models/foo/manifest.json', json=manifest, if_none_match=expected)
```

maria: So hybrid model: local nodes use rename path for speed; remote uses versioned staging + atomic manifest PUT. Loader must validate checksums and tolerate stale manifests.

ben: Recovery playbook (loader side):
1) read manifest.json
2) verify all shard checksums
3) if missing/incomplete -> look for staging versions sorted by timestamp
4) validate candidate staging sets and attempt promote (copy) to live path OR update symlinked pointer
5) if no valid staging -> look for .zip fallback or previous stable version

deepa: Tests: add 'interrupt-conversion' harness that kills writers mid-upload; assert loader will either find a valid previous version or recover from staging. Add chaosrunner test.

chris: I'll add 'accept_partial' loader flag to allow best-effort loads of present shards (zero-fill missing) for inference-only use cases. We'll gate behind model config.

maria: Action items: @ben prototype manifest+recovery script; @deepa add interrupted-write tests; @chris update loader to tolerate partial+zip fallback; schedule review Friday 10am. :calendar:

ben: ack :thumbsup:

deepa: will add CI tests and perf checks

chris: on it, will open PR for loader change and include compatibility shim for older manifests
